request.deadline: Three-month liquidity deployment after enactment with monthly reporting; no overall final delivery date stated beyond staged deployment and milestone conditions
deliverables: Shared BTC reserve architecture with transparent reserve-ratio mechanics and safety zones
Composable Cardano-native FIRE and ICE assets
Open-source SDKs and adapters for wallets, DEXs, and DeFi protocols
Always-on public dashboards for reserve ratio, supply, liquidity health, fee flows, and deployment status
Monthly governance reports and reporting standards
Independent security review, audit, and economic modeling
Three-month staged treasury-supported launch liquidity deployment
Legal, compliance, disclosure, treasury reporting, and launch-readiness work
Go-to-market, ecosystem education, DRep communications, partner activation, and launch coordination
request.recipient: Sundial Protocol and Charms, with Intersect proposed as interim fund administrator subject to confirmation and final agreement
request.what: Withdraw treasury funds to build and launch Alchemy, a Cardano-native Bitcoin treasury/BTCfi infrastructure layer with FIRE and ICE assets, reserve architecture, dashboards, integrations, reporting, audits, administration, and staged launch liquidity.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 10,000,000 ada, using an approximate USD 0.20 per ada reference rate for an approximately USD 2.0 million planning budget split into two approximately USD 1.0 million pools.

Pool 1 will support protocol infrastructure and staged launch liquidity, remain separate from operating expenses, deploy over three months, and return profits, yield, and returns generated by the launch liquidity position to the Cardano Treasury quarterly.

Pool 2 will fund delivery, audit, integrations, dashboards, governance reporting, legal and compliance work, and go-to-market execution with itemized planning allocations totaling approximately USD 1.0 million.

Alchemy will use a shared BTC reserve for FIRE and ICE with reserve-ratio formulas, a 5.0x initial target reserve ratio, and safety zones that constrain minting, redemption, and risky activity as reserve conditions weaken.

FIRE is described as a residual, volatility-absorbing BTC exposure asset, while ICE is described as a lower-volatility USD-denominated BTC-backed exposure asset, and both are intended to be composable Cardano-native primitives.

The proposal asserts that Cardano currently lacks a serious production BTCfi infrastructure layer and that failure to fund Alchemy would leave Bitcoin-backed structured exposure to consolidate on other chains and off-chain markets.

The proposal cites external references and named market examples, including Strategy Q1 2026 results, Strive, Apyx, Saturn, and Pendle, to support the claim that demand for Bitcoin-backed structured exposure is meaningful and growing.

The proposal says launch liquidity principal may be returned to the Treasury after Alchemy reaches a 30-day time-weighted average TVL of at least USD 60 million, subject to a separate formal governance proposal and review.

The proposal includes treasury protections including no DRep funds or personal compensation to Sundial or Charms principals, a rollover commitment if external investment funds development, ADA price protection above USD 0.35, pause rules, refund conditions, administrator oversight, and auto-abstain delegation for administrator-held ada.

The proposal acknowledges BTC volatility, oracle, bridge, Charms protocol-layer, novel asset, delivery, and adoption risks, and states mitigations including overcollateralization, security review, modeling, staged launch, dashboards, pause rules, legal/compliance work, milestone gating, and administrator oversight.

summary: The document proposes a 10,000,000 ada treasury withdrawal for Sundial and Charms to build and launch Alchemy, a Cardano BTCfi infrastructure protocol with FIRE/ICE assets, reserve mechanics, staged treasury-supported liquidity, audits, dashboards, integrations, reporting, administration, and governance controls.
